messages:
marie: I'm filing a small PR to the Optimize toolkit: clarify short-sequence defaults and add a tiny Go snippet + one-line Rust pointer. Also there's a bad link to /optimize/batching that returns 404.

tonY: can you spell out recommended batch_size for seq_len<=128? Support keeps asking.

marie: recommending batch_size 6-12 for seq_len <=128, note to monitor latency. Adding a compact Go snippet for copy-paste: 

```go
package main
import ("fmt"; "github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk")
func main(){c:=redwood.New("$REDWOOD_KEY");r,_:=c.Generate("redwood-opt-1","Summarize:",40);fmt.Println(r.Text)}
```

kevin: I'll fix the sidebar link to /optimize/batching -> /optimize/batching-and-caching.

docs-bot: @marie created PR #4622 (optkit: shortseq note + examples)  CI queued.

marie: added a short JSON quant profile example and a one-line callout: "kv_prefetch=true by default; set false for seq_len > 1024 or when using huge batches."

tonY: LGTM. Ping when CI is green and I'll merge after a staging preview.

docs-bot: CI passed  sampler build OK, link-check OK.

kevin: merged and added migration changelog entry: "optkit: short-seq guidance + quick SDK example; sidebar link fix."

marie: thanks all. Will monitor support for any follow-ups.
